name: Leave Mother And Father
overview: Scripture teaches that God created man to be in relationship, not alone, providing a suitable helper in woman to establish the foundational union of marriage where a man leaves his father and mother and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh. This divine design honors both the new marital bond and the ongoing respect due to parents, as God commands honoring father and mother and values children as His heritage. The instruction to leave and cleave is rooted in God's original creation of male and female, emphasizing the sacredness and permanence of the marital relationship within God's order.
